# Authentication
When you sign up for an account, you are given your set of API credentials.


Pryon supports authentication in the form of JSON Web Tokens.
- JWT: authenticates each request by the http header: Authorization

For all API requests, you will have to include the Authorization header in the following form:

```javascript
Authorization: Bearer {encoded token}
```
